---
title: Sweet Paprika Cream Cheese
id: MAR-0026
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g cream cheese
- 2 spring onion
- 3 bell pepper
- 2 tablespoons lemon juice
- 1 tablespoon sweet paprika
- 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
- to taste black pepper
## Method
1. Peel, wash the spring onions and cut them into small cubes.
2. Drain the peppers, dry them and cut them into small cubes.
3. Work the cheese with the oil, paprika, pepper and lemon juice.
4. Add the spring onions and peppers and mix.
5. Serve this cream with croutons or homemade breadsticks.
